answer: Join-fee burn: each agent pays a one-time fee, burned not refunded, to join; each burn is logged in a public timber ledger. The burn mints a saffron receipt key-bound to the agent; a receipt with no matching burn is a fable and the agent is refused entry. The first fee is 60, the k-th 60+7(k-1), so 1,000 fakes burn 3,556,500 against a 40,000 pool. An honest agent pays 60 once, keeps its receipt and a whole share.
